summary: K. R. Norman was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Downing College, Cambridge, under Harold Walter Bailey. He spent his career at the University of Cambridge (1955–1992) and served as editor of the Pali Text Society Journal (1981–1994).

K. S. Balasubramanian works in Indology and philosophy. He has been affiliated with the Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, where he served as an Editorial Committee member (attested 2001) and Director (attested 2026).

K. Sambasiva Sastri was an Indologist who served as Curator at the Department of Oriental Manuscripts Publications from circa 1924 to 1938, succeeding T. Ganapati Sastri.

K. V. Puttappa was a linguist who studied at Hardwick High School and College, Maharaja's College, Mysore, and the University of Mysore between circa 1924 and 1929.

K. V. Rangaswami Aiyangar was an Indologist and historian who served as Principal of Central Hindu College and Banaras Hindu University from circa 1935 to 1940.

Kaetan Andreevich Kossovich was an Indologist and Iranian studies scholar who studied at Moscow State University under Aleksej Stepanovič Homjakov. id: P:Kah Tok Wön Trul Tsultrim Yönten Gyatso
